options.text: You keep the vessel date and bring a pump crew over from the mainland on overtime.
options.fb: Money buys pump fitters and not switching authorisation, which is what those two hold. The vessel date survives and there is nobody licensed to open the cable.

options.text: You hold the vessel booking and decide when the pump repair is scoped.
options.fb: Deciding after the pump scope is deciding in three weeks, and the window is seven away.

steps.prompt: One of the two linesmen who hold the switching authorisation asks for ten minutes. He keeps his own notebook of every operation on this cable — date, weather, and how the shore end sounded coming back in — and he has never been asked to hand it over, nor offered. Two of the entries say the same thing about cold nights.

options.text: You record it as an observation with his name on it and put it in the survey scope.
options.fb: The load recorder has 20 years of amperes and no account of what the shore end did coming back in. His notebook is the only record of the switching operations themselves, which is the thing that kills these cables.

options.text: You ask him to keep a log of when he hears it, with dates and temperatures.
options.fb: He has kept the log for twenty years already. Asking him to start one is how the twenty existing years stay unread.

options.text: You ask the survey engineer whether that sound means anything.
options.fb: He will say it could mean four things, which is true, and he has never seen a laid cable of this age.

options.text: You note it and carry on, since it is not measurable.
options.fb: He is one of the two who must sign for the switching, and he has just been told his twenty years are not measurable.

steps.prompt: The island hall is full, the diesel station is still out, and Cranmore has no backup at all. Word that the operator is doing something about the cable reached the island through the vessel's crew, and what people want to know is whether the lights go out and when. What is genuinely undecided is the other half — what happens to the cable — and inside this funding cycle nothing decides it until a joint is opened, which this window will not reach. Two ways of running the meeting are open and they differ in kind.

options.text: You put the undecided half to the hall and say what would decide it.
options.fb: They carry the consequence of all four actions. A room told what is not yet decided can argue about the trigger; a room told a decision can only argue about the decision.

options.text: You present the work as the plan and keep the cable question internal.
options.fb: It gives the hall a clear answer about the week and none about the decade, which is the part they will return to.

options.text: You put it to the hall and ask them to choose what happens to the cable.
options.fb: The trigger is theirs to argue about and the choice is not: replacing a cable off a network budget is a judgement the operator is licensed to make and cannot hand over.

options.text: You announce the work and take questions.
options.fb: The crew have already told the island that something is wrong with the cable. Announcing only the week of work is how the rest arrives later, from them.

B3a.prompt: The hall does not split the way anyone expected. The fishing families, who lose most if the cable goes in a gale, say replace it and be done with it. The retired and the families with young children want the cheapest thing that keeps the lights on. Both are asking the operator to decide, and both now expect to be told the answer.

options.text: You give them the date you will decide by and what you will decide on.
options.fb: The room did not ask to be given the decision. It asked to know that one is coming and on what. Both of those are yours to give tonight.

options.text: You take the fishing families' view, since they carry the loss.
options.fb: They carry one loss, and the people who carry the other one were in the same room and quieter.

options.text: You say the operator will weigh it and come back.
options.fb: They were told that once already tonight, and somebody says so out loud.

B3b.prompt: The meeting is short and calm. Three days later a crew member tells the island shop that the cable might have to be replaced, and the harbour master, who chairs the community council, rings to ask why the meeting did not mention it.

options.text: You admit it was not yet decided and put the trigger in writing.
options.fb: The admission costs one call. The trigger in writing buys that the next thing the island hears about this cable comes from the operator and not from the shop.

options.text: You explain that nothing was certain enough to raise until the window was decided.
options.fb: Accurate, and it is the answer of an organisation that will decide again what the island is ready to hear.

options.text: You offer to hold a second meeting once the survey result is in.
options.fb: A second meeting after the result is the first meeting again, with the island having spent the interval on the shop's version.

title: What You Cannot Say
note: МАКЕТ. Тексты и веса наши, ни одной формулировки PrepMatter (Ф3). Развилки по РОДУ хода (Ф21). Связывающее — ОБОСНОВАНИЕ ЗАПЕЧАТАНО: причина сбоя установлена, но названа быть не может, пока идёт спор, и каждое честное объяснение читается как признание собственной вины. Против семнадцати семей: 01 данные · 02 календарь · 03 окно · 04 чужие активы · 05 необратимость · 06 доверие · 07 деньги с датой · 08 очередь · 09 два правила · 10 ресурс во времени · 11 успех ломает механизм · 12 знание в одном человеке · 13 доказательство не масштабируется · 14 обязательство, взятое до тебя · 15 заказчик не один · 16 рынок узнаёт нужду в момент вопроса · 17 актив, который нельзя проверить. Ключ A>S>D>H: печать снимает только тот, кого она защищает, и цена просьбы растёт в момент, когда совет скажет что-нибудь сам. Рубрика против матрицы родов круга 44.

intro.head: Welcome to the Sustainable Futures Lab
intro.body: You have joined a small team advising a borough council. You will make thirteen decisions. There is one clock for all of them, and you cannot go back.

intro.head: Background
intro.body: Halston collects waste from 34,000 households on 62 rounds, under an eight-year contract of which 3 years have gone and 5 years remain, at £3.2m a year. Missed collections have gone from 400 a week to 1,200, all of them on the same nine rounds, and the call centre logged 5,200 complaints last month, which is where the 1,200 comes from. The cause is established and the council may not say it: it sits inside a live adjudication, and the contract's confidentiality clause binds the council alone — what the two parties agree to say together is not caught. The adjudicator determines in fourteen weeks. Every explanation the council is free to give by itself reads as the council's own failure. Local elections are in nine weeks. The contract lets the council withhold a tenth of the fee — £320,000 a year in all, calculated round by round, a little over £5,161 a year for each of the 62. Terminating costs £2.9m, and running the service in-house would cost £4.1m a year, £900,000 more than the contract, so leaving costs £7.4m over the 5 years that remain.
intro.mission: Your mission: fix a service and be judged on it, with the reason sealed.

priorities.label: Ask the contractor to agree a form of words, the one thing the clause does not catch
Tell residents this week whatever the council is free to say
Establish which rounds fail and why, to the standard the remedy needs
Decide between terminating, withholding and riding it out

steps.prompt: Put these four actions in the order you would take them, starting with the one you would do first.
steps.why:
Связывающее — **обоснование запечатано**. Причина установлена, но названа быть не может, пока идёт спор, и каждое объяснение, которое совет вправе дать, читается как признание собственной вины. Новая семья: в «Signed Before You Came» руки связывала чужая подпись, здесь связан **язык**, а действовать и отвечать надо в полный рост.
Первым — **просьба к подрядчику**. Печать снимает только та сторона, которую она защищает, и просьба о совместных словах — это один звонок и один черновик. Но её цена не постоянна: **она растёт в ту минуту, когда совет скажет публично хоть что-нибудь**. Пока объяснений не было, подрядчику совместное заявление ничего не стоит; после первого же публичного слова совета оно становится признанием, и его больше не подпишут.
Возражение сильное: **жители страдают сейчас**, и молчать неделю ради переговорного хода — это поставить процедуру выше людей. Возражение верное по чувству и неверное по счёту. Просьба — это звонок, а не процедура; процедура стоит три недели, и её как раз и предлагает юрист. И первое публичное заявление бывает одно: неделя жалоб стоит дорого, но неверное первое слово стоит остатка года, потому что каждое следующее будет читаться через него.
Жители вторыми, и сразу: сказать можно и без снятой печати — про то, что делается, и про то, что говорить пока нельзя. Данные третьими: замер нужен не для объяснения, а для средства защиты по договору, и он идёт своим темпом. Решение о судьбе договора последним: нового основания у него пока нет, и появится оно только если после восстановления часть маршрутов не сдвинется. До тех пор есть лишь девять недель до выборов, а это давление, а не основание.

feedback.top: You ask while the ask is still cheap, because the price of it rises the moment the council says anything in public.
feedback.mid: Workable: the contractor is not last, and there is still a version of this where the reason can be said out loud.
feedback.low: This order speaks first and asks afterwards, which is the one order in which the seal never lifts.

steps.prompt: The contractor's managing director takes the council's calls. The clause stops the council saying it alone; it does not stop the two parties agreeing a form of words, and it does not bind him at all when he speaks about his own operation. Legal advises that any approach be routed through the adjudication, which adds three weeks.

options.text: You put a two-paragraph draft to him directly and ask him to sign it.
options.fb: A draft is a much smaller ask than a principle. He can strike a line; he cannot strike a request he has not seen.

options.text: You ask him to agree, in principle, that a joint statement would be helpful.
options.fb: He will agree in principle. Principles are what people agree to when they intend to negotiate the words later, and later is after the election.

options.text: You route it through the adjudication as legal advises.
options.fb: Correct, safe and three weeks. The clause forbids the council speaking alone, and asking the other party to speak with you is not speaking.

options.text: You wait for the determination and say nothing until the reason can be given.
options.fb: Fourteen weeks of a service failing in public, and an election inside it.

steps.prompt: Nothing has come back from the contractor this week, whether or not he was asked, and the seal is still on. The communications team has drafted an apology. The leader wants to say the council is «working with its contractor»; the monitoring officer says that phrase alone identifies who is at fault to anyone who reads it twice.

options.text: You publish what is being done and say plainly that the reason cannot be given yet.
options.fb: «We cannot say why» is itself a fact, and it is the only one the council owns. An apology without it invites residents to supply the reason, and the one they supply is the council.

options.text: You publish the apology and the recovery plan without touching the question of cause.
options.fb: Complete, professional and silent on the only thing being asked. The silence gets filled by the fourth day.

options.text: You use the leader's phrase, since it is true and stops short of naming anyone.
options.fb: It stops short of naming and points squarely. If it is read as blame, the council has broken the clause without the benefit of having said the thing.

options.text: You say nothing publicly and answer complaints individually.
options.fb: 5,200 individual answers in a month, each one a version of the story, and none of them the council's.

steps.prompt: The managing director asks for a meeting, alone, no lawyers. He will not sign anything the council could put in front of him as it stands — his own board would have to see it first, and his board sits within days, not the weeks the adjudication takes; that answer is the same however he was approached. But he is in the room, and he wants to know what the council actually needs. Two ways of using the meeting are open and they differ in kind.

options.text: You describe exactly what the council needs said, and leave him to choose the instrument.
options.fb: He is not bound the way the council is: nothing stops him speaking about his own operation. Naming the need rather than the instrument is what leaves him room to use that.

options.text: You ask him what he can do, and take whatever he offers.
options.fb: An open question to the party with the information, and the answer will be shaped by what is comfortable for him rather than by what the council is missing.

options.text: You set out the council's position and ask him to respond to it.
options.fb: A position is a need with armour on. He will respond to the armour, and the meeting he asked for without lawyers becomes one with them.

options.text: You ask him to explain the failures to you first, so the council knows what it is dealing with.
options.fb: The council already knows: it is in the adjudication papers. Spending the one informal hour on what is already documented is the cheapest way to waste it.

B1a.prompt: He offers one thing: his operations director will sit with the council's team and go through the round data line by line. It is not a statement and it is not signed. The council's own figures and the contractor's disagree on which collections count as missed.

options.text: You take it, and start by agreeing what counts as a missed collection.
options.fb: Two organisations counting the same lorries differently is the whole of the numbers disagreement. Settling the definition is worth more than either number.

options.text: You take it and go through the disputed rounds first, since that is where the money is.
options.fb: The disputed rounds are disputed because the definition is. Starting there means arguing the same argument nine times.

options.text: You decline, since anything said in that room could reach the adjudication.
options.fb: It could, and the adjudication is about the same numbers. Refusing to reconcile them protects a position the council would rather not have to hold.

B1b.prompt: What he offers is what suits him: his own recovery plan, in writing, with dates. It says nothing about cause, and its dates are a fortnight later than the recovery timetable the council has been working to, which was the council's own estimate of his capacity.

options.text: You take the plan and ask, in writing, why his dates differ from the timetable the council has been working to.
options.fb: The difference is either capacity or caution, and the answer is worth more than the plan. Written, it also becomes something the adjudicator will read.

options.text: You accept the plan and quietly move the council's timetable to match.
options.fb: The dates align and the council has just adopted the contractor's timetable as its own, for free, a fortnight late.

options.text: You reject it and hold him to the council's timetable.
options.fb: Holding him to it is holding him to a number he never gave.

steps.prompt: The adjudicator writes to both parties. What he finds is his own and the clause does not reach it. He determines in fourteen weeks whatever is put in front of him, and he offers an early view on one narrow question if both sides agree the question. The early view itself takes eleven weeks, so it lands after the election either way, and the clock on the determination does not move. The council can have the early view on cause, or on the value of the remedy, not both.

options.text: You take the early view on cause, because it is the thing the council may not say.
options.fb: Neither answer arrives before the election, so the choice is not about the next nine weeks — it is about what the council will be able to say for the 5 years that remain. A finding on cause is a third party's fact, and a third party's fact is sayable.

options.text: You take the early view on the value of the remedy, since that is money now.
options.fb: £320,000 is real and it is recoverable at the determination in any case. What is not recoverable is five years of a reason nobody may give.

options.text: You ask for both and let the adjudicator choose which he answers.
options.fb: He asked for one agreed question. Sending two is how a narrow offer becomes a scheduling matter.

options.text: You take neither and keep the full case for the determination.
options.fb: The full case lands in fourteen weeks and the narrow one in eleven. Declining the early view keeps nothing and costs three weeks of sayable fact.

steps.prompt: The council's own contract manager comes forward. For a year he has been agreeing changes to round boundaries with the depot supervisor by phone, to keep the service moving, and none of them went through the variation procedure. Some of the nine rounds are not the rounds the contract describes. The depot keeps its own record of the same calls. He has been here since before the contract was let, and he is frightened.

options.text: You establish which rounds were changed and by how much, before deciding about him.
options.fb: The size of the problem and the fate of the man are two questions, and only one of them is urgent. Four rounds changed is a detail; nine is the council's whole case gone.

options.text: You put it to legal at once, since the adjudication is live and this is disclosable.
options.fb: It is disclosable and it will be disclosed. Sending it up before anyone knows its size means the council reports a catastrophe it has not measured.

options.text: You take his account as it stands and correct the case around it.
options.fb: His account is a frightened man's memory of a year of phone calls, and the depot's record of those calls is sitting there unread.

options.text: You thank him and deal with it after the determination.
options.fb: He has told somebody. The next person he tells will be asked why the first one did nothing.

steps.prompt: The recovery is real but partial: the missed collections are down on six of the nine rounds and unchanged on three. The adjudicator's disclosure list reaches the depot's call log whether or not anyone went looking, and it has been pulled and counted: how many of the nine are not the rounds the contract describes is known to the officers by now; whether those variations stand is not. Members want a decision before the election. Two responses are open and they differ in kind: press the contract, or press the operation.

options.text: You withhold on the three that have not moved and pay in full on the six that have.
options.fb: Withholding everywhere punishes the recovery you asked for. Three rounds at £5,161 recovers almost nothing against £3.2m a year — the money is not the point of it. Withholding exactly where nothing moved is the one version the contractor can act on and the adjudicator can read.

options.text: You put council crews onto the three rounds and bill the contractor for it.
options.fb: It collects the bins, which is the point, and it takes the council from claimant to operator in the middle of its own adjudication.

options.text: You withhold the full £320,000 and say so publicly.
options.fb: The maximum, on rounds that are recovering, announced in the week the adjudicator is reading. It is the strongest possible signal of the weakest possible judgement.

options.text: You take the three rounds in-house permanently and re-scope the contract around it.
options.fb: Re-scoping a live contract inside a live dispute rewrites the thing being disputed.

B2a.prompt: The contractor's response to money being held back is to serve a notice of its own: it says the council's round specifications changed without variation, and it reserves the right to claim. The claim, if it runs, lands well after the determination.

options.text: You answer the notice on its merits and change nothing about the withholding.
options.fb: A reserved right is not a claim, and reversing a decision because one was mentioned teaches what a notice is worth here.

options.text: You release the withholding while the notice is examined.
options.fb: Prudent and it concedes the point the notice was written to concede: that the withholding is arguable.

options.text: You add the notice to the adjudication as evidence of bad faith.
options.fb: Serving a notice to protect a position is ordinary. Calling it bad faith gives the contractor a second thing to defend, and he will defend it at the same hearing.

B2b.prompt: Council crews go onto the three rounds and the contractor's site manager starts routing his own lorries around them. Whether the council took them by notice or by re-scope, the paperwork has not caught up with the lorries: within a fortnight nobody can say which organisation is responsible for which street, which is the question the adjudication turns on.

options.text: You write down daily which streets the council covered, and copy it to him.
options.fb: The record has to exist before anyone needs it. Copied daily, it also stops being the council's word against his.

options.text: You pull the council crews back to restore a clean boundary.
options.fb: The boundary is clean again and the three rounds go back to being missed.

options.text: You leave it and sort the responsibility out at the determination.
options.fb: The determination will ask who collected what. Sorting it out then means reconstructing a fortnight nobody wrote down.

steps.prompt: The adjudicator asks both parties to file their missed-collection count. Both numbers are wrong and they are wrong in opposite directions. The council's 1,200 a week comes from the call centre and counts a street twice when two neighbours ring. The contractor's figure comes from the in-cab tablets, which log a round as completed when the last bin is lifted and cannot see a street the lorry never entered. The depot books every lorry out and in against a round each morning and has done for years; nobody has ever read those sheets against the complaints. Whatever the two sides have settled between them about what counts, neither filed figure was built round by round, and neither knows which round it belongs to.

options.text: You build the count round by round off the depot's daily sheets and put that in.
options.fb: The round is the unit the adjudication decides in, and the sheets are the only record that knows which round a street sat on. They are also the council's own, kept for years for a different purpose.

options.text: You put his tablet figure in as the council's own starting point and reconcile down from it.
options.fb: A party that opens with the other side's number has nothing left to be caught out on. It is also a total, and a total cannot be attached to the three rounds the case now turns on.

options.text: You correct the council's figure and put the corrected one in, with the method.
options.fb: Honest and self-serving in the same breath: a number corrected by its own author still arrives as the author's number.

options.text: You keep the 1,200, since it is the number already in the papers and in the press.
options.fb: It is in the papers because nobody has checked it, and he has the tablets.

steps.prompt: The finance director has found a way to make the year balance: capitalise the recovery costs against the contract's residual value, which is permitted and which nobody outside finance will read. It removes the pressure to decide anything before the election.

options.text: You take the accounting and keep the decision on the same date it was on.
options.fb: The treatment is legitimate and the pressure it removes was doing useful work. Keeping the date is what stops a permitted entry from becoming a postponement.

options.text: You take it and move the decision to after the determination.
options.fb: Defensible on every fact and it means the council decided its timetable on an accounting entry.

options.text: You decline it and let the overspend show.
options.fb: An overspend that shows is a discipline and it is also a headline in the week before an election, about a cause nobody may explain.

options.text: You take it and tell members the pressure is off.
options.fb: The pressure was the only thing keeping the decision on a date.

steps.prompt: Three rounds are still not being run to the contract — by him, or since council crews went on, not by him at all — and that is either a default or a re-scope the council has not papered. Both are things the council could act on without waiting for the determination, provided those three are rounds the contract still describes — the count is known, the status is not. Leaving needs somewhere to go: £2.9m to terminate plus £900,000 a year for the 5 years that remain is £7.4m. The only other contractor with vehicles on this side of the county is committed to the neighbouring borough until week twelve. The borough buys the same winter cover from the council that the council would now be asking of it, and will want the same favour back one winter. Two ways forward are open and they differ in kind.

options.text: You ask the neighbouring borough what would release capacity sooner.
options.fb: Week twelve arrives two weeks before the determination on its own, which is a date and not an option: nothing can be started on it. Only the borough can say whether those weeks move, and the asking costs nothing.

options.text: You build the in-house case at £4.1m and put it to members as the alternative.
options.fb: £7.4m priced properly and put in front of members, which makes leaving a decision about money rather than a threat. It is also the number the contractor will read in the papers.

options.text: You ask the neighbour and the county's other authorities at the same time.
options.fb: Asking six people the same question is how the contractor learns the council is shopping, from the fourth one.

options.text: You cost the in-house option and hold it unpublished as leverage.
options.fb: Leverage that is never shown is a spreadsheet. Leverage that is shown once is a decision members will have read about first.

B3a.prompt: The neighbouring borough will talk, and its chief executive asks the obvious question in return: what happened, and is it going to happen to us. She is asking in confidence, and the seal does not distinguish between confidences.

options.text: You tell her the council is bound, and that you will tell her the day it is not.
options.fb: She buys from the same market and she will remember which answer she got. A confidence broken for her benefit is one she has to assume will be broken about her.

options.text: You tell her in confidence, since she is a fellow authority and needs to know.
options.fb: She does need to know, and the clause does not have an exception for people who need to know.

options.text: You say there is nothing she should be concerned about.
options.fb: That is not being bound, it is being untrue, and she is about to lend the council lorries.

B3b.prompt: The in-house figure has reached members — by paper or before it — and two of them read £900,000 a year as the price of the council's own mistake. The officer who built the case, whose arithmetic is not in doubt, is asked in committee whether the number is reliable.

options.text: You answer for the number yourself, in the room.
options.fb: He is about to defend a decision he did not make, on a number nobody disputes. Whoever chairs the officers decides now whether the next honest number arrives early or late.

options.text: You let him answer and correct anything that needs correcting after.
options.fb: He will answer well and he will learn what happens to an officer who produces an inconvenient figure.

options.text: You take the question away and offer a written answer.
options.fb: A written answer to a question asked in public is read as the second draft of the first one.

title: Nothing Happened
note: МАКЕТ. Тексты и веса наши, ни одной формулировки PrepMatter (Ф3). Развилки по РОДУ хода (Ф21). Связывающее — ДОКАЗАТЕЛЬСТВО ОТСУТСТВИЯ: программа оценивается по событию, которого не будет, и чем лучше она сделана, тем слабее улика. Против восемнадцати семей: 01 данные · 02 календарь · 03 окно · 04 чужие активы · 05 необратимость · 06 доверие · 07 деньги с датой · 08 очередь · 09 два правила · 10 ресурс во времени · 11 успех ломает механизм · 12 знание в одном человеке · 13 доказательство не масштабируется · 14 обязательство, взятое до тебя · 15 заказчик не один · 16 рынок узнаёт нужду в момент вопроса · 17 актив, который нельзя проверить · 18 обоснование запечатано. Ключ S>A>H>D: рамку сравнения можно согласовать только ДО вмешательства, а диагностика здесь не предшественник, а покупка. Рубрика против матрицы родов круга 44. Миры объявлены ДО текста.

intro.head: Welcome to the Sustainable Futures Lab
intro.body: You have joined a small team advising an infrastructure owner. You will make thirteen decisions. There is one clock for all of them, and you cannot go back.

intro.head: Background
intro.body: Northmoor Rail owns 620 earthworks on its route — cuttings and embankments, many older than the line. There have been nine failures in five years, and three of the nine were on slopes that had never been assessed. One failure last winter shut the route for 11 days and cost £3.4m in delay payments and repair. The control period fund is £46m. It buys deep stabilisation at £2.3m a slope, which treats 20, or survey and drainage at £230,000 a slope, which reaches 200, or any mix of the two, and it does not roll into the next period. 74 of them are already classed high risk. The regulator renews the fund on demonstrated benefit, and the benefit of this programme is a set of failures that will not occur. The one framework contractor with rigs in the region is bid into the sector's own cycle from month nine, after which its rate is £2.7m a slope.
intro.mission: Your mission: spend £46m on events that will not happen, and be believed.

priorities.label: Tell the regulator on what basis the programme will be judged, before the money moves
Take the framework's rigs before the sector's cycle books them out
Decide the rule by which £46m splits between deep treatment and route-wide survey
Establish which of the 620 earthworks are nearest failure

steps.prompt: Put these four actions in the order you would take them, starting with the one you would do first.
steps.why:
Связывающее — **доказательство отсутствия**. Программа удалась ровно тогда, когда показывать нечего: результат — сходы, которых не будет. Чем лучше сделано, тем слабее улика. Новая семья: в «The Pilot That Worked» доказательство было и не масштабировалось; здесь его **не будет вовсе**, и нести его может только рамка сравнения.
Первым — **регулятор и основание оценки**. База сравнения наблюдаема только ДО вмешательства: после того как откосы укреплены, необработанного близнеца на них больше нет, и остаётся единственное основание — балл состояния, то есть оценка работы её же собственным инструментом. Это письмо, а не проект, и стоит оно один день.
**Буры вторыми**, потому что их цена лежит на чужих часах: с девятого месяца отраслевой цикл забирает их, и ставка идёт с £2.3m до £2.7m за откос. Просьба дёшева, а дорожает она без участия Northmoor.
Возражение сильное, и оно защищает именно ВТОРОЕ место, а не последнее: **буры дорожают по чужим часам, а письмо не дорожает ни на день — значит буры первыми**. Возражение неверно по природе двух потерь. Цена буров РАСТЁТ на известную величину: £400,000 за откос, деньги, и их можно заплатить. Основание оценки не дорожает — оно ИСЧЕЗАЕТ, и исчезает не по дате, а в день первой лопаты: на укреплённом откосе необработанного близнеца больше нет, и купить его обратно нельзя ни за какие деньги. Между дорожающим и исчезающим первым берут исчезающее.
И отдельно про последнее место, потому что оно контринтуитивно. «Сначала разберитесь, где рвётся» верно на ремонтной программе и неверно на предупредительной: здесь «разобраться» — это и есть одна из двух покупок фонда, маршрутное обследование стоит половину денег. Поэтому D не может стоять раньше H: **диагностика не предшественник решения, она им оценивается**.
Раскладка фонда третьей: она обратима, пока буры не расписаны по конкретным откосам, и именно она назначает цену диагностике. Диагностика последней — не потому что она неважна, а потому что до трёх предыдущих ходов она не имеет ни рамки, ни бюджета, ни исполнителя.

feedback.top: You fix the basis of proof while an untreated comparison still exists, and you buy the rigs while their price is still yours to pay.
feedback.mid: Workable: the basis is not last, and there is still a version of this where the programme can be shown to have worked.
feedback.low: This order spends first and agrees the test afterwards, which is the one order in which nothing can be proved.

steps.prompt: The renewal test has to be chosen, and the guidance names two acceptable bases and will accept either if it is agreed before the works begin: a counted baseline, where failures on named untreated slopes are counted against the treated ones, or condition scoring, where the score itself is the outcome. After the works start only condition scoring remains available, because on a treated slope there is no longer an untreated comparison.

options.text: You propose the counted baseline now, naming the comparison slopes.
options.fb: The comparison has to exist before the treatment does. Naming the slopes is what stops them being chosen afterwards, when every candidate is either treated or already failed.

options.text: You write now proposing condition scoring, which is simpler and available either way.
options.fb: Available either way is the weakness, not the merit: a basis that can be adopted at any time is one nothing was paid to secure, and it scores the work by its own instrument.

options.text: You ask the regulator which basis it would prefer.
options.fb: An open question to the body that will judge you. It will name the basis easiest for it to audit, which is not the basis that shows what the money did.

options.text: You begin the works and settle the basis at the period review.
options.fb: Starting first is the one move no later ruling can undo. Whatever basis is imposed afterwards, the slopes it would have compared are by then either treated or already failed.

steps.prompt: The framework contractor's rigs are uncommitted this year. From month nine the sector's own cycle takes them and the rate goes to £2.7m a slope. He holds capacity against a signed order and not against an intention. Northmoor has not yet decided what it is buying.

options.text: You order rig weeks, with the slopes named later.
options.fb: Weeks are what the cycle takes away; slopes are what has not been decided. Buying the scarce thing without pretending to have decided the other is the whole of the move.

options.text: You order against the 20 at the top of the current risk list.
options.fb: It holds the rigs, and it also fixes the split before any survey exists. The fund gets spent by an order form.

options.text: You order a short block now and extend it once the split is decided.
options.fb: The block is real and the extension is at whatever the rate is when you ask for it, which is the one part of this you were trying to control.

options.text: You order through the sector's own framework, which guarantees the rigs.
options.fb: Guaranteed, at £2.7m from the first slope instead of from month nine. Paying the late price early to avoid deciding is the most expensive kind of tidiness.

steps.prompt: The regulator has come back on one point and one only, and it did not ask what was proposed: for a preventive programme it will accept the counted baseline and nothing else. Which slopes are in the comparison group is open. Meanwhile a select committee is taking evidence in public on last winter's 11 days and Northmoor is a witness: whatever is said there is on the record, and the regulator's staff read the record. Two ways of using the session are open and they differ in kind: put the basis of proof into the public record, or answer on the closure and keep the basis in correspondence.

options.text: You state the basis of proof and invite the members to bind themselves to it publicly.
options.fb: A basis nobody can quietly re-choose later is worth more than a basis that is merely correct. Said in public, it costs the regulator something to change and costs Northmoor its own escape route, which is the point.

options.text: You answer on the closure and leave the basis where it is, in correspondence.
options.fb: Correct, narrow and reversible by either side. The correspondence is where a basis goes when both parties want the option of a different one.

options.text: You state the basis and add that the regulator has not agreed it yet.
options.fb: Accurate, and it hands the committee a disagreement to be interested in instead of a test to hold you to.

options.text: You answer on the closure and promise the committee a note on how success will be measured.
options.fb: A promised note is a deadline you set for yourself on the one question where the deadline was already set by the works starting.

B1a.prompt: The committee clerk asks for the comparison slopes by name, for the record. The only list Northmoor has is the risk list, and the assessment behind it predates the fund on a third of the entries.

options.text: You give the list, flagging the older entries on the record.
options.fb: A comparison group with a known weakness is still a comparison group. One whose weakness is discovered later is not a group, it is an argument.

options.text: You give the list as it stands.
options.fb: It is the list you have and it will be read as the list you chose. The third that is old will be found by somebody who is not you.

options.text: You offer the list once the assessment behind it has been refreshed.
options.fb: Refreshing it is the survey, and the survey is the thing the fund has not been committed to yet. The clerk asked for a list, not for a programme.

B1b.prompt: The case officer follows up in writing with the condition attached to the group. She will hold the counted baseline only if a slope in the comparison group cannot be treated inside the period, and a slope once treated cannot be moved into the group later. She notes, without comment, that nothing said outside the correspondence binds either side.

options.text: You accept the condition and say which slopes it takes off the table.
options.fb: A group that cannot be edited is the only kind that proves anything, so the condition is what makes the baseline worth having. Naming its price now is what stops that price arriving as a surprise in year three.

options.text: You accept the condition and leave the comparison group exactly as drawn.
options.fb: Accepting is right, and the group as drawn holds slopes Northmoor will want to treat. The condition then gets met by not treating them, which is a decision nobody will have made on purpose.

options.text: You ask her to allow substitutions on notice.
options.fb: A group with substitutions on notice is a group chosen after the event, which is the thing the condition exists to prevent.

steps.prompt: The £46m has to be committed as a rule, not as a wish. Deep stabilisation at £2.3m a slope treats 20 of the 74 already classed high risk; survey and drainage at £230,000 a slope reaches 200 and builds nothing. Split in half, £23m buys 100 surveys and £23m buys ten deep treatments. The rigs are held either way.

options.text: You split it in half: 100 surveys, ten deep chosen from them.
options.fb: Three of the nine failures were on slopes nobody had assessed, so the scarcest good here is not concrete, it is knowing where to put it. Half the money buys a list; the other half buys ten slopes chosen from that list instead of from an older one.

options.text: You spend it all on survey and drainage and reach 200.
options.fb: It reaches 200 and leaves the route with a far better list and nothing built. Drainage is real work, and the 74 already known stay exactly as they are.

options.text: You spend it all deep and treat the 20 at the top of the risk list.
options.fb: Twenty slopes properly done, chosen by an assessment that predates the fund. It is the version that looks most like delivery and is the most exposed to the list being wrong.

options.text: You hold the fund until the basis of proof is agreed.
options.fb: Every week of holding it raises the price of what it will eventually buy, and the money still has to be committed by the same period end, by somebody who will then have less time to choose.

steps.prompt: The county highways authority has a slip on the road that carries the rail replacement diversion. It has no rigs of its own; the framework's are held by Northmoor whatever the fund was committed to, and from month nine the sector takes whatever is not used. The county asks for two rig weeks. If the route shuts again this winter, the diversion runs on that road.

options.text: You release the two weeks, taking their slope into your monitoring.
options.fb: The weeks are worth less to Northmoor than the diversion is, and the exchange turns a favour into an instrumented slope of the same geology, which is the one thing the county has and cannot value.

options.text: You release the two weeks.
options.fb: Right on the diversion and free of charge. The county would have paid something, and what it could have paid is the thing this programme cannot buy with money.

options.text: You keep the weeks and offer the county your assessment method instead.
options.fb: A method is not a rig. The road stays shut, and a diversion route that is shut is not a diversion route.

options.text: You keep the weeks, since the fund is for the railway.
options.fb: It is, and the railway's resilience runs over that road for 11 days at a time.

steps.prompt: In February — month eleven of the period, with the rigs already inside the sector cycle — a slope fails. It was on the risk list, it was not among anything treated, and the line is shut for four days. The board wants to know what Northmoor says about it. Two responses are open and they differ in kind: use the failure as part of the programme's case, or handle it as an operational matter and leave the case where it was.

options.text: You record it as a baseline event on an untreated slope, in the letter's terms.
options.fb: The counterfactual arrived by itself. A failure on a named untreated slope is exactly what the counted baseline is for, and it is the only evidence this programme will ever get for free.

options.text: You handle it operationally and keep the programme's case out of it.
options.fb: Clean, and it throws away the only failure Northmoor will be able to point at. Prevention programmes are not given many of these.

options.text: You use it publicly to argue the fund is too small.
options.fb: The argument is probably right and it is made in the week the failure is being read as a delivery failure. Asking for more money on the day you are being asked what you did with the last is a matter of sequence, not of merit.

options.text: You issue the operational notice and let the coverage run.
options.fb: The coverage will supply the explanation. It will be the one where a programme with £46m did not treat a slope on its own list.

B2a.prompt: The regulator's case officer writes back. However the failure was put — as a baseline event or as an argument for a larger fund — it was a failure on a named comparison slope, and she asks who decides which slopes are in that group now that one of them has failed.

options.text: You freeze the group as it was named, and say why.
options.fb: The whole value of naming them early was that nobody could revise the group afterwards, including Northmoor. Saying so is what makes the first move worth what it cost.

options.text: You offer to let the regulator name the group from here.
options.fb: It answers the suspicion and it gives away the thing that was secured before the works: a comparison chosen in advance rather than by the party grading the work.

options.text: You add the failed slope to the treatment list and move on.
options.fb: That removes it from the comparison group by treating it, which is the exact manoeuvre she was asking about.

B2b.prompt: A member asks in the House why a £46m programme did not treat a slope that sat on its own risk list, and the operational notice is the only thing on the record.

options.text: You answer with the split rule, not with regret.
options.fb: The rule is defensible and the regret is not: 74 are known, the fund reaches what it reaches, and the choice of rule is the answerable part.

options.text: You answer that the slope was scheduled for a later year.
options.fb: True, and it invites the only follow-up that matters — what else is scheduled for a later year — with no rule to answer it.

options.text: You answer that the fund is too small for the risk on the route.
options.fb: It is, and said here it reads as a programme explaining in advance why it will not work.

steps.prompt: A permanent-way supervisor with 22 years on this section keeps a notebook: which cuttings weep after rain, which fences move, where the ballast washes. None of it is in the asset system. Two of the nine failures are in the notebook, marked, in the years before they happened. He retires in the spring.

options.text: You put a surveyor alongside him for his last months.
options.fb: The notebook is worth what it is worth because he can say which entry mattered and why. After the spring it is a book of place names.

options.text: You have the notebook copied and indexed.
options.fb: You get every entry and lose the reason each was written. The value was never in the ink.

options.text: You add his slopes to the survey list.
options.fb: It uses him as a pointer and throws away what pointers are for. He can say which one he would go and look at tonight.

options.text: You ask him to write up anything important before he goes.
options.fb: Everyone asked to write up what matters writes up what is easy to write.

steps.prompt: The regulator's efficiency test disallows any scheme whose cost per failure avoided exceeds £3.4m, the value it places on a failure. On the current risk list about one treated slope in three would have failed within the period, so each avoided failure costs three deep treatments: £6.9m against a threshold of £3.4m. The test is published and it is arithmetic. Two things on this route can flag a slope without each other: an inspection walk-over, and the section's own maintenance history. They do not share a method and they have never been read together. The rule set at the committal stands; the tranches under it are not all placed.

options.text: You raise the hit rate instead of arguing the threshold: treat only what two independent sources both flag.
options.fb: One in three is a property of the list, not of the rule, and it is the only term in the fraction Northmoor can move. Agreement between two sources that do not share a method is what moves it, and nothing else in the arithmetic is Northmoor's to touch.

options.text: You argue the £3.4m undervalues a failure, since it counts delay and repair and not the speed restrictions afterwards.
options.fb: Probably true, and it is an argument to move a published number, made by the party that benefits from moving it, in the year it is being applied.

options.text: You move what is left of the fund to survey and drainage, which the test does not reach.
options.fb: It does not reach it because drainage is not scored as avoidance at all. Passing a test by leaving its category is not passing it.

options.text: You carry on as committed and put the case at the period end.
options.fb: £6.9m a failure, presented after the money is gone, to the regulator that published the threshold before a penny of it was spent.

steps.prompt: The tell-tales have been on the route for years and they give a clean, strong signal: movement rises with rainfall and the worst of it is on the long shallow cuttings. All nine failures were on slopes whose measured movement was low. The mode is not creep — it is sudden loss of toe support, and the instruments cannot see it. Targeting has been resting partly on this data throughout. Two ways forward are open and they differ in kind: say now that the instrument measures the wrong thing, or check it against the nine before saying anything.

options.text: You put it to the regulator before the next targeting round.
options.fb: The data is not wrong, it is about something else, and every round that passes spends money chosen by it. Saying it first is also the only version where Northmoor is the party that found it.

options.text: You check it against the nine first, and then say it.
options.fb: Nine cases is a weak check and a defensible one. The cost of the delay is that the next tranche is ordered on the old basis while it runs.

options.text: You raise it at the committee as a lesson learned.
options.fb: The committee is not the body that funds the next round, and a lesson learned is how a finding gets filed instead of acted on.

options.text: You quietly stop using the movement data in the targeting from here.
options.fb: The targeting improves and the record still says the data supported it. The next person to check will find the gap and not the reason.

B3a.prompt: The regulator asks the question that follows — from the letter or from the committee transcript, it reaches her either way. The comparison slopes were chosen partly on movement data, so is the counted baseline affected. She is not suggesting an answer.

options.text: You re-draw the group on geology and toe condition.
options.fb: A group chosen by an instrument that measures the wrong thing is not a comparison, and saying so before she works it out is the only version where the replacement is Northmoor's to draw.

options.text: You keep the group and record the caveat.
options.fb: The caveat is honest and the group is still selected by the wrong variable. A recorded caveat does not repair a sample.

options.text: You argue the group is still valid because both sides were chosen the same way.
options.fb: Both sides being chosen wrongly makes the error common, not absent, and she asked the question because she had already thought of that.

B3b.prompt: Whether it was checked against the nine or simply dropped from the targeting, the conclusion is Northmoor's own now. The rigs are inside the sector cycle: any slope the new targeting names is re-ordered at £2.7m, which is £400,000 a slope above the framework rate.

options.text: You re-order at £2.7m for the slopes the new targeting names.
options.fb: £400,000 a slope is the price of not building on an instrument that measures the wrong thing. Against £3.4m a failure it is not a close question, and it is a question that gets more expensive every tranche.

options.text: You keep the order as placed and re-target the next tranche.
options.fb: It saves the rate and spends this tranche on slopes chosen by a variable you have just established is the wrong one.

options.text: You keep the order: the difference is not defensible against a check nobody has published.
options.fb: The check is Northmoor's own and it is not going to become less true by staying unpublished.
